title: Bounded live search, recovery and source receipts
blockers: 38.1: Authorised provider contracts and explicit query/source/budget policy
38.2: PubMed and Europe PMC cursor paging through the existing shared runtime
38.3: Atomic checkpoints, resume and idempotent record emission

claim_boundary: Source-level planning or implementation is not compiler, authorised live, real-consumer or independent methodological evidence. Screening/stopping, extraction/entailment and VOI remain with their own tools; track closure requires independently verifiable admission.
